# Brand strategy

## Directives

No directive is in force at this node.

## Definition

The choices about what a brand means to the people it serves: its identity, the associations that it builds in their memory, and its place among the brands they compare it with. Brand strategy starts from the positioning of the product. The voice and the visual identity then express it.

## Notes

Alina Wheeler notes that a brand cannot be authentic until the organization is clear about its market, its positioning, its value, and its difference from competitors. That is why the positioning of the product informs this practice area.
